game.title: Grand Theft Auto III – The Definitive Edition

roadmap.title: Portland: side content before hostile gangs
roadmap.description: After the intro, finish Luigi's Girls, then Paramedic, Firefighter, Vigilante, taxi fares, rampages, packages and RC missions before the Triads and Mafia turn hostile. Save before each one-shot mission (Mike Lips Last Lunch, Lee Chong, The Fuzz Ball, Triads and Tribulations) and finish every Luigi, Joey, Toni and Marty Chonks mission before Last Requests.

roadmap.title: Staunton Island: kills, weapons and Kingdom Come
roadmap.description: Do Yardie rampages first, then finish Kingdom Come, collect weapons for Full Artillery, kill gang members, and finish A Drop in the Ocean. Do all Kenji Kasen missions before Waka-Gashira Wipeout! and Two-Faced Tanner before Grand Theft Aero.

roadmap.title: Shoreside Vale: collectibles and finale
roadmap.description: Open Shoreside Vale, finish the vehicle missions, unique jumps, RC missions, bribes and packages, then play The Exchange last among story steps.

roadmap.title: Cleanup and 100%
roadmap.description: Check the stats screen for any missed 100% item. Keep something other than Kingdom Come for last. Then the remaining totals unlock.

achievements.summary: Complete the story mission @loc{Luigi's Girls}.

steps.text: Play the intro mission, then finish @loc{Luigi's Girls}.

achievements.description: Return Mike Lips' car without a scratch.
achievements.summary: Return Mike Lips' car to Marco's Bistro after the bomb is fitted, without any damage.

guide.context: This is a one-shot mission and is lost for the playthrough once finished without the condition. Save before starting. If the car gets damaged, the game sends you to the Pay'n'Spray and the achievement fails. Fail the mission on purpose and restart it.

steps.text: Start @loc{Mike Lips Last Lunch} from @npc{Joey Leone}, then steal Mike Lips' Idaho from @loc{Marco's Bistro}.
Drive carefully to @loc{Eightballs Autoyard} in Harwood so the bomb can be fitted. Avoid every crash.
Drive back to the bistro with no damage.

achievements.summary: Use 20 police bribes.

guide.context: Bribes are the floating police star pickups; each one removes a wanted star. Completing Vigilante kills on each island adds up to 6 extra bribes at your safehouses. The stats screen does not count bribes used.

steps.text: Get a wanted level, then pick up a bribe. Repeat until you have used 20.
Refill safehouse bribes by finishing Vigilante kills (10 and 20 per island).

achievements.description: Crush a car at the junkyard.
achievements.summary: Crush a car at the Harwood junkyard.

guide.context: The crusher scene in @loc{Dead Skunk in the Trunk} does not count, so crush a car separately.

steps.text: Drive any car into the cordoned-off area of the junkyard in @loc{Harwood}.
Get out and wait for the crane to pick up and crush the car.

achievements.description: Keep both Mafia members alive during the mission.
achievements.summary: Keep both Mafia partners alive through the mission @loc{Triads and Tribulations}.

guide.context: This one-shot mission is lost for the playthrough once finished without the condition. Save before starting. If a partner dies, fail the mission on purpose and restart it.

steps.text: Start @loc{Triads and Tribulations} from @npc{Toni Cipriani} with two Mafia partners.
Kill the first Triad warlord in @loc{Chinatown} by drive-by. Kill the second in the walking-only alley quickly, then return to the car.
Kill the third warlord from the hill behind the Fish Factory wall, shooting over the wall.

achievements.summary: Kill 100 gang members.

guide.context: Kills from all seven gangs count together. Rampages and story missions usually cover it.

steps.text: Kill gang members from the Triads, Mafia, Diablos, Cartel, Yakuza, Yardies or Southside Hoods until you reach 100.

achievements.description: Take out Lee Chong with a car rigged with a bomb.
achievements.summary: In @loc{Farewell 'Chunky' Lee Chong}, kill Lee Chong using a booby-trapped car.

guide.context: This one-shot mission is lost for the playthrough once finished the normal way. Save before starting. The bomb service at @loc{Eightballs Autoyard} opens in the previous mission, @loc{Mike Lips Last Lunch}. If the bomb is not rigged or triggered, fail the mission and restart it.

steps.text: Start the mission, then steal Lee Chong's Perennial from the south or west entrance of the @loc{Chinatown} alley before he notices you.
Drive it to @loc{Eightballs Autoyard}, in Harwood, and buy the car bomb fitting.
Park the car in the same spot and arm the bomb with the detonate key.
Walk to the alley's north entrance so Lee Chong runs to the car. Let him get in and drive off. The bomb kills him.

achievements.description: Use a Coach to pick up and deliver all 8 girls at once.
achievements.summary: Deliver all 8 girls in one Coach during @loc{The Fuzz Ball}.

guide.context: This one-shot mission is lost for the playthrough once finished the normal way. Save before starting. Getting the Coach before you begin is safest, though there is spare time to fetch it later.

steps.text: Take a Coach from the bus depot east of @loc{Joey's Garage} in Trenton.
Start @loc{The Fuzz Ball} from @npc{Luigi} and pick up all 8 girls in the Coach.
Drive the full load to Chinatown's @loc{Old School Hall}. The achievement unlocks as you drop them off.

achievements.description: Complete the "Turismo" race in under 180 seconds.
achievements.summary: Win the @loc{Turismo} checkpoint race with a time below 180 seconds.

guide.context: Turismo can be replayed after all of @npc{El Burro}'s phone missions. The Mafia become hostile after @loc{Sayonara Salvatore}, so finish this on Portland before that mission.

steps.text: Get a fast car such as a Banshee, Stallion or Sentinel. A Banshee is sold at the dealer near the @loc{8-Ball} garage.
Start @loc{Turismo} at @npc{El Burro}'s payphone after @loc{Van Heist}.
Race through the checkpoints without crashing or flipping and finish in under 180 seconds.

achievements.summary: Land a perfect insane stunt.

guide.context: It usually happens during the unique stunt jumps. Any ramp launch landed cleanly on all wheels counts.

steps.text: Launch a vehicle off a ramp and land cleanly on its wheels. Doing the unique stunt jumps in a sports car is a good way.

achievements.summary: Complete all 20 unique stunt jumps.

guide.context: A success shows a message on screen. Do jumps outside missions, since a jump done during a mission may not count. A fast car like the Banshee, Cheetah or Infernus helps.

achievements.description: Kill 25 gang members with melee weapons / fists.
achievements.summary: Kill 25 gang members using only fists or melee weapons.

guide.context: Triads and Diablos carry only bats and pistols, so Chinatown or Hepburn Heights is easiest. Do this early, before gangs hunt you.

steps.text: Pick up a Baseball Bat at your safehouse.
Go into Triad or Diablo territory and beat gang members to death with the bat or fists until you reach 25.

achievements.summary: Complete 100 taxi fares.

guide.context: Fares can be done on any island and across any number of sessions. The game can crash, so save about every 25 fares. The Borgnine Taxi appears in Harwood after 100 fares.

steps.text: Get into a Taxi or Cabbie and start the Taxi Driver mission with the vehicle-mission key.
Take each passenger to the marked drop-off before time runs out. Repeat until you have 100 fares.

achievements.description: Survive with less than 10 hp for 1 minute.
achievements.summary: Stay alive for a full minute while health is under 10.

steps.text: Lower your health below 10 with a fall or a fight.
Get out of combat and stay alive for 60 seconds.

achievements.description: Use every weapon in the game at least once.
achievements.summary: Fire or use each weapon type in the game one time.

guide.context: Rampages use most weapons. Weapons are free at safehouses with enough hidden packages, with Firefighter progress, or sold at Ammu-Nation and Phil's Army Surplus.

steps.text: Use melee: Fists and Baseball Bat. Use guns: Pistol, Shotgun, Uzi, M-16, AK-47, Sniper Rifle. Use heavy and thrown weapons: Rocket Launcher, Flamethrower, Grenade, Molotov Cocktail.
Also use the Detonator once, on a car bomb you have fitted.

achievements.summary: Complete the story mission @loc{Last Requests}.

guide.context: This mission permanently closes any remaining Luigi, Joey and Toni story missions and the Marty Chonks phone missions. Finish all of them first, or the playthrough cannot reach 100%.

steps.text: Finish every @npc{Luigi}, @npc{Joey Leone} and @npc{Toni Cipriani} mission, and every @npc{Marty Chonks} phone mission.
Play @loc{Last Requests} for @npc{Salvatore Leone}. It opens Staunton Island.

achievements.summary: Complete the story mission @loc{A Drop in the Ocean}.

guide.context: It opens Shoreside Vale.

steps.text: Sail to the airport runway's far end and shoot the plane down.
Collect the packages from the water.
Go back to @npc{Donald Love}'s tower while you have 4 wanted stars.

achievements.summary: Complete the final story mission @loc{The Exchange}.

guide.context: The Cartel gets Uzis and AK-47s afterward, so finish Shoreside Vale rampages and vehicle missions first. Also finish @loc{Kingdom Come} on Staunton Island before this mission.

steps.text: Begin @loc{The Exchange} from the Cartel Mansion, in @loc{Cedar Grove}.
Fight out of the mansion and follow @npc{Catalina}'s helicopter to the dam.
Use the rocket launcher at the helipad to shoot down the helicopter.

achievements.summary: Complete the phone mission @loc{Kingdom Come}.

guide.context: The Yardies turn hostile afterward, so finish Yardie rampages first. Do not leave this as the last 100% task or the 100% achievement will not unlock.

steps.text: Answer @npc{King Courtney}'s payphone on Staunton Island, then drive to the car park in @loc{Bedford Point} and enter the vehicle.
Destroy all four suicide-bomber vans and their bombers. Grenades dropped while you run work well.

achievements.summary: Complete all four RC Toyz missions.

guide.context: The vans do not show on the map. Destroying one target car in each mission is enough. The two Portland missions need @loc{Luigi's Girls}, Casino Calamity needs @loc{Last Requests}, and Rumpo Rampage needs @loc{A Drop in the Ocean}.

steps.text: @loc{Diablo Destruction}: enter the TOYZ van in Hepburn Heights and blow up a Diablo Stallion with the RC car.
@loc{Mafia Massacre}: enter the TOYZ van in Saint Mark's, opposite Momma's Restaurante, and blow up a Mafia Sentinel.
@loc{Casino Calamity}: enter the TOYZ van northwest of Kenji's Casino and blow up a Yakuza Stinger.
@loc{Rumpo Rampage}: enter the TOYZ van behind your Wichita Gardens safehouse and blow up a Hoods Rumpo XL.

achievements.description: Extinguish 15 fires during a single Fire Truck mission.
achievements.summary: Put out 15 fires in one Firefighter run.

guide.context: Do not ram a burning car; it explodes and ends the run. Finish this on Portland before the Triads and Mafia turn hostile. Firefighter progress needs 20 fires per island, which need not be in one run.

steps.text: Get into a Fire Truck and start the Firefighter mission with the vehicle-mission key.
Spray fires with the hose from a distance until you have put out 15 without failing.

achievements.summary: Complete Paramedic level 12 in one run.

guide.context: One failed run restarts at level 1. Leaving the Ambulance, destroying it or killing a patient fails the run. Each level adds one patient and the Ambulance holds three. Brake around corners to avoid flipping. Do this on Portland before story missions; later, try Staunton Island away from the Yardies and Cartel.

steps.text: Get into an Ambulance and start the Paramedic mission with the vehicle-mission key.
Plan your route on the map. Pick up patients and take them to the hospital, making extra trips from higher levels.
Reach and finish level 12.

achievements.description: Kill 15 criminals during one Vigilante mission.
achievements.summary: Kill 15 criminals in one Vigilante run.

guide.context: Finish this on Portland before the Triads and Mafia turn hostile. An Uzi helps for drive-bys. A Rhino or FBI Car also makes it easier. Vigilante progress needs 20 kills per island, which need not be in one run.

steps.text: Get into a police car or another law-enforcement vehicle and start the Vigilante mission with the vehicle-mission key.
Chase the marked criminals and kill 15 before time runs out.

achievements.summary: Hold a total of $1,000,000.

guide.context: All 100 hidden packages pay $1,000,000 and @loc{The Exchange} pays $1,000,000.

steps.text: Collect money from missions, packages and jumps until you hold $1,000,000.

achievements.summary: Reach a criminal rating of 2,500.

guide.context: The rating rises from kills and destroyed vehicles. The stats screen displays it near the top.

steps.text: Cause kills and explosions until your criminal rating reaches 2,500.

achievements.summary: Complete the Paramedic, Firefighter and Vigilante missions.

guide.context: Each needs full progress: Paramedic level 12, 20 fires on each island, and 20 criminals on each island.

steps.text: Reach level 12 in Paramedic in one run.
Extinguish 20 fires on every island, three islands in total.
Take down 20 criminals on every island, three islands in total.

achievements.summary: Find all 100 hidden packages.

guide.context: Each package pays $1,000 and every 10 unlock a safehouse item. A crash loses unsaved packages because the game autosaves only at mission start and end. Packages 16 and 33 need Staunton Island to be open.

achievements.summary: Reach 100% completion.

guide.context: Check progress on the stats screen. Finish Luigi, Joey, Toni and Marty Chonks missions before @loc{Last Requests}, all Kenji Kasen missions before @loc{Waka-Gashira Wipeout!}, and @loc{Two-Faced Tanner} before @loc{Grand Theft Aero}; otherwise a new playthrough is needed. Do not leave @loc{Kingdom Come} as the last task.

steps.text: Complete all story missions, all 17 phone missions, the 4 off-road missions, the 4 RC missions and the 4 vehicle missions.
Finish the 3 Import/Export lists, all 20 rampages, all 20 unique jumps and all 100 hidden packages.
Check that the stats screen shows 100%.

achievements.summary: Unlock every other achievement.

steps.text: Earn all other achievements in the game.
